product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker is an asset lifecycle management platform that helps critical-infrastructure asset owners and operators plan, develop, construct, operate, and maintain their projects and assets.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing is available as a Scout pricing-terms PDF rather than a conventional pricing landing page. It lists subscription packages and on-demand credits at $0.13 per 100 credits.

named_customers.notes: Customer-story summaries explicitly describe both companies using Sitetracker.

employee_band.notes: Company-size band listed on Sitetracker's LinkedIn page.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index contains industry advice, product content, and infrastructure-operations articles, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building Sitetracker.

public_docs.notes: Detailed object and integration documentation is behind a Salesforce Community login; no public multi-article documentation or developer portal was identified.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Open posting: Senior Software Engineer II - AI.

model_provider.notes: The terms state that advanced AI and data products are powered by Amazon Bedrock; they do not identify the underlying third-party foundation models.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center displays a SOC 2 Type II report and ISO 27001:2022 certification.

last_funding.notes: The September 28, 2022 announcement comprises $66 million in Series D equity and a $30 million revolving credit facility. NTT DOCOMO Ventures subsequently announced its investment in October 2022 without disclosing an additional amount; no later distinct round was identified.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified funding activity dates to 2022, outside the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Open posting: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Middle East).

launched_6mo.notes: On September 23, 2026, Sitetracker and 5×5 Technologies introduced a portfolio-scale data-to-digital-twin workflow for wireless infrastructure owners.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: JP Akouri's profile dates his Sitetracker Vice President of Sales role to June 2026, following a GPS Insight role ending in May 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sitetracker states that its platform is built natively on Salesforce; this is a platform/integration signal, not proof of its internal sales-team tooling.
